def f(I, w='v'):

    vp=[(c,I[0][c]) for c in vcols]; hp=[(r,I[r][0]) for r in hrows]
    nV,nH=len(vp),len(hp)
    L,Wd=2*nH+1,2*nV+1
    out=[[0]*Wd for _ in range(L)]
